subject: [SENDER] / Jisung - Intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well! Thought I'd reach out since we recently started working
with Motive & Automotus on developing very similar computer vision models
with the goal of migrating them away from legacy in-house infrastructure &
speeding up their expansion into new smart city use cases.

We're mostly assisting with improving model quality / delivery speed while
keeping development costs low as they scale through better end-to-end data
mgmt and by allowing them to curate/annotate high resolution videos
natively on our platform.

Bit of context on Encord...we're a computer vision scale-up (recently
raised a $30M Series B) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation,
workflow management and model evaluation under one platform.

We've been following Metropolis for a while now and would love to get your
candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord if you have 15 mins
to chat. Open to a quick call next week? Wednesdays / Thursdays afternoon
work best on our end, however very happy to work around your schedule.

subject: Working with Onfido, Veriff & others
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

We've recently started working with Onfido, Veriff & iProov, helping to support real-time verification of their multimodal model outputs, so thought it might be interesting to explore if we can help at Incode in a similar way.

Believe our teams may have chatted before - but reaching out as we have since made significant investments to support a broader range of modalities (Documents, Video & Audio), improve our real-time processing capabilities, and expand our VPC / on-premise deployment options.

The challenge we consistently heard from our ID verification partners was that QA workflow bottlenecks were slowing their ability to launch new products / scale to new markets - so was curious to understand if this was also top of mind at Incode?

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning from working with Onfido, Veriff & iProov and similar partners in the space.

Would it be worth us re-connecting?

text:

Would it be worth us connecting?
